slot_scores.name: operating_cost_treatment
slot_scores.evidence_quote: is the "Operating Costs at Full Capacity" a fixed cost incurred whenever the machine is used at all, or a cost proportional to the fraction of its effective hours actually used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the operating costs are fixed or proportional, directly targeting the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0/P1 hidden slot, H1, was resolved in turn 1 before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; remaining deferred items were not hidden slots and were clearly marked as defaults.

summary: The agent directly clarified the key operating-cost treatment and then stopped appropriately after resolving the only P0/P1 hidden slot, while transparently noting unresolved non-hidden defaults.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
